svg.title: P19: Budgeted loop with caps collaboration and interaction

text.tspan: Primitive · A² A2 · gauge role collaboration
The harness can consume bounded turns, steps,
Accounting approaches or exceeds a configured cap.
Resource ledger, cap policy, terminal reason, and
Execution stops or changes policy before an
Relevant resource use is observable and
outcome and records the responsible cap.
Budget exhaustion is never reported as task
Missing accounting or handler failure falls
back to a safe terminal policy.
1 enqueue(work) → 2 account(work) → 3 report(usage) → 4 evaluate(cap) → 5 stop_or_escalate() → 6 continue(allowance)
Evidence: 30/41 repositories, 27/36 families; 30 trajectories (17 multi-checkpoint); exact audit: not sampled.
Variation: Step, turn, token, cost, wall-clock, delegation, and per-task budgets.
Negative control: A constant limit in an unrelated library does not meet the pointcut.
